# Nest Workspaces

> Coworking space and photo and video studios in Cebu City, Philippines. Day passes, memberships, private offices, meeting rooms by the hour, studio rentals and an event venue for 60 to 100 guests, all at B1, Horizons 101 Condominiums, Gen. Maxilom Ave, Cebu City.

- Hours: walk-ins daily 7 AM to 1 AM. Members have 24-hour access.
- Phone: (0945) 451 0789 · Email: hello@nestworkspaces.com · Messenger: https://m.me/nestworkspacesph
- Free parking, 300 Mbps internet, free coffee, tea and water.
- Payment: cash, GCash, credit and debit cards, bank transfer. Students get 10% off; PWD and senior citizens get 20% off.

## Pages

- [Coworking](https://nestworkspaces.com/coworking): Day Pass ₱400 (7 AM to 1 AM), Owl Pass, Week and Flexi Passes, memberships with 24-hour access from ₱5,500 a month, dedicated desks and private offices from ₱20,000 a month.
- [Meeting rooms](https://nestworkspaces.com/meeting-rooms): 6-seat room ₱400 an hour, 12-seat room ₱900 an hour, with smart TV, whiteboard and coffee.
- [Studios](https://nestworkspaces.com/studios): Studio 1 (12 by 4 meter infinity wall) from ₱9,000 for 4 hours, Studio 3 from ₱2,000, or the Entire Studio from ₱14,000 for 4 hours. Lights, backdrops and dressing room included.
- [Events](https://nestworkspaces.com/events): the Entire Studio for 60 to 100 guests, from ₱14,000 for 4 hours, with tables, chairs, projector and speaker.
- [Visit](https://nestworkspaces.com/visit): directions, map and how to book a tour.
- [FAQ](https://nestworkspaces.com/faq): hours, rates, internet, food, payments and discounts.
- [Find your space](https://nestworkspaces.com/find-your-space): a short quiz that recommends a pass, room or studio.
- [Stories](https://nestworkspaces.com/stories): guides and news from Nest.
